desc: The Crosman Mag-Fire Extreme features a refined approach to multi-shot, break-barrel technology raising the bar over current technology. The patented 12-shot design delivers the lowest profile in its class and utilizes fewer components to reduce failure or jamming. Featuring Quietfire sound suppression, an adjustable stock, Picatinny rail and 3-9x40AO scope, the result is the ultimate in performance and reliability whether you are on the range or in the field.
